terminus.finding: Zeng Tsai-shan's 2007 study of public-private cooperation in Taiwan creative parks ranks software-side capabilities—industry assistance, R&D incentives, international exchange and joint marketing—above hardware-side arrangements; it also ranks a PPP center, equipment/land cooperation and joint events within the hardware dimension.
terminus.generated: The switching-power model needs a capability precondition. A network may have many channels and formally distributed actors yet remain practically inert if participants lack translation, coordination, learning or resource-mobilization capacity. Conversely, capability-building can change effective connectivity without changing the formal topology. Proposed distinction: topology power asks who can alter available relations; activation capacity asks who can make an available relation actually work.
